title: Normalize and block candidates
brief: Normalize known inconsistencies and expose plausible candidates without altering the reference.
instructions: Normalize text with lower/trim, replace runs of non-Unicode-letter/digit characters with one space, and collapse whitespace. Do not transliterate Unicode. Account keys use lower/trim with blanks NULL; source keys use trim only with blanks NULL. Keep the smallest partner ID for each non-NULL source key; keep missing keys separate. Map hw, hard ware, and hardware to hardware; supplies remains supplies. Parse strict ISO YYYY-MM-DD, US MM/DD/YYYY, or DD Mon YYYY, in that order; invalid dates become NULL. Preserve all source rows unchanged.

Emit one row per account-block pair using the normalized partner values; sort by reference then partner. A pair whose date text cannot be parsed still belongs in the output with a NULL date: an unparseable date is a value to report, not a reason to drop the pair.
starterSql:
SELECT ref_id, account_key, category, event_date, description, quantity, business_unit
FROM reference_events
ORDER BY ref_id
LIMIT 10;
starterExplanation: Inspect immutable reference identities and raw evidence first. This source-only preview intentionally does not yet normalize or enumerate partner candidates.

hints.text: Normalize first, deduplicate physical replays, then join the complete account blocks.
Use separate normalized reference and partner relations; retain the smallest physical ID for each nonblank event key before joining.
Malformed dates stay in the candidate block. Distinct event keys with identical values are not replays.
